items.task: Create a real-life situation that uses turns as measures of rotation. Record the quantities and explain your reasoning.
Find one example at home/school of full, half and quarter turns. Draw or photograph the representation and label it.
Design a pair activity for acute, right, obtuse and straight angles. Each partner must explain the answer in a different way.
Collect two measurements or observations connected to measuring turns with an angle tool and compare them.
Make a small poster teaching clockwise and anticlockwise movement to a younger learner. Include one worked example.
Invent a challenge based on directions after turns; exchange it with a classmate and check the solution.
